evidence: Gate dimensions carry the real hard gate: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both judge.toml use aggregation="all_pass" with one binary criterion. render/authenticated_render requires a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat (not blank page, static mock, generic error, fatal browser error), nothing private before sign-in (instruction.md:7), wrong password rejected, and gwen@kittle.test opening her matters and messages. constraints/server_backed_local_application adds server backing: Gwen posts "Gate check JUDGE-G1" in M-11, it survives reload, and harriet@kittle.test in a separate browser context sees it, so a localStorage/static facade fails; it explicitly allows external font/script/CDN requests 'Under the declared public network posture' and never requires same-origin (only that the app is reached from the local server at localhost:3000, which is server-backing, not same-origin; matches quality-checks.md #35 note and integration.md:3). Each scored prompt (functional/prompt.md, polish/prompt.md, visual/prompt.md 'Global browser gate' paragraph) restates the in-dimension gate: loads from localhost:3000 without fatal error, gwen signs in and sees protected content appropriate to the current state, external assets allowed, blank page/empty workspace/static mock/static shell/missing backend/seeded-looking facade fails, protected content must be backed by the running local server, and 'If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension' (no partial credit; polish/visual name it 'the only all-or-nothing rule'). This is a strengthened superset of the frozen template's gate text. Conforming-alternative check: gwen is client of M-11/M-13, M-11 has no walls, 7-day timer and fixed clock make a new message fresh, any viewer may post (walls-and-retention.md:15), and no functional criterion walls Gwen or removes her matters, so a correct app keeps passing the Gwen-based gate in every individual functional session and in polish/visual after functional writes ('appropriate to the current state'). Broken-app check: a static shell or client-only store fails the cross-context persistence leg and the scored gates. Workbook conflict noted: Internal Quality Checks C30 says gates hard-zero 'cross-origin apps', but the client Quality Checks row, SKILL.md delivery profile and quality-checks.md #29 say network is public and the gate must NOT require same-origin; the task follows the current rule. Runtime: scripted golden on current source hashes passed gate_constraints (functional-before.json); render gate and the configured judge on these bytes are unmeasured (hosted Oracle render/constraints 1.0 and nop 0 are for previous v2 bytes only), hence risk=true for missing runtime evidence, not for a defect.
